verdict.rationale: Mintlify explicitly documents per-PR preview deployments with unique preview URLs so reviewers can view doc changes before merging (mintlify-docs-17, -35, -49), plus editor-based preview-then-merge workflow (mintlify-docs-12/25) and CLI local preview (mintlify-docs-11/29). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the preview-URL workflow in practice and detail on how previews integrate with GitHub PR checks/comments.
